notes: Video paths are relative to the project's workout/ folder and are served only by exercise id.
video: null means no demonstration video exists; the player shows a written guide instead.
Dose, rest and cadence defaults below are conservative coaching defaults for this prototype, not prescriptions validated for every person.

barbell.label: Barbell
barbell.description: Bar and plates (a rack for squats and presses).

dumbbell.label: Dumbbell
dumbbell.description: One or more pairs of dumbbells.

machine.label: Gym machine
machine.description: Leg press, rows and other selectorised machines.

stretching.label: Stretching and mobility
stretching.description: Adds a mobility block to the main workout.

trx.label: TRX suspension trainer
trx.description: Suspension straps with a secure anchor.

exercises.name: Marching in place
exercises.description: Easy marching to raise your temperature without impact.
instructions: Stand tall and march, lifting each knee to about hip height.
Swing the opposite arm with each knee.
mistakes: Leaning back to lift the knees higher.
exercises.safety: Keep it easy; this is a warm-up.

exercises.name: Running in place
exercises.description: Light jog on the spot.
instructions: Jog on the spot on the balls of your feet.
Keep the arms bent and swinging.
exercises.safety: Stop if it causes pain in feet, ankles or knees.

exercises.name: High knee taps
exercises.description: Quick knee lifts to the hands.
instructions: Hold your hands at hip height.
Drive alternate knees up to tap the hands at a quick, controlled pace.
cues: Stay tall; knees up, not body down.
exercises.safety: Moderate impact: skip it if jumping or running hurts.

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.description: Jog on the spot bringing heels toward the glutes.
instructions: Jog lightly on the spot.
Bring each heel up toward your glutes.
exercises.safety: Stop if your knees or ankles hurt.

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.description: Classic jumping jacks.
instructions: Jump the feet apart while raising the arms overhead.
Jump back together with arms down.
cues: Land softly on the balls of the feet.
exercises.safety: Moderate impact: choose a no-jump step-jack if jumping is uncomfortable.
exercises.regression: Step jacks (step out instead of jumping).

exercises.name: Arm circles
exercises.description: Small to large arm circles, forwards then backwards.
instructions: Arms out to the sides.
Draw small circles, gradually making them larger; switch direction halfway.
exercises.safety: Keep circles small if your shoulder is sensitive.

exercises.name: Leg swings
exercises.description: Front-to-back leg swings holding a support.
instructions: Hold a wall or post for balance.
Swing one leg forwards and back in a relaxed, growing arc.
Switch legs halfway.

exercises.name: Hip circles
exercises.description: Slow circles of the hips with hands on the waist.
instructions: Hands on hips, feet shoulder-width.
Draw slow circles with the hips; switch direction halfway.
mistakes: Moving the shoulders instead of the hips.
exercises.safety: Small circles if your back is sensitive.

exercises.name: Knee-to-wall ankle rocks
exercises.description: Gentle ankle mobility: rock the knee forward over the toes toward a wall.
instructions: Stand in a split stance facing a wall, front foot a few inches away.
Keeping the heel down, rock the front knee toward the wall and back.
Switch sides halfway.
exercises.regression: Move the foot closer to the wall.
exercises.progression: Move the foot slightly further away.

exercises.name: Standing quadriceps stretch
exercises.description: Gentle static stretch for the quadriceps, hip flexors.
instructions: Hold a support for balance.
Bend one knee and hold the ankle behind you, knees together.
Switch sides halfway.
cues: Breathe slowly and relax into it.
exercises.safety: Mild tension only; never stretch into pain.

exercises.name: Kneeling hamstring stretch
exercises.description: Gentle static stretch for the hamstrings.
instructions: Kneel and straighten one leg in front, heel down.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long back.
Switch sides halfway.
cues: Breathe slowly and relax into it.
exercises.safety: Mild tension only; never stretch into pain.

exercises.name: Lunging calf stretch
exercises.description: Gentle static stretch for the calves, ankles.
instructions: Step one foot back into a short lunge.
Press the back heel down until you feel the calf.
Switch sides halfway.
cues: Breathe slowly and relax into it.
exercises.safety: Mild tension only; never stretch into pain.

exercises.name: Hip flexor stretch
exercises.description: Gentle static stretch for the hip flexors, quadriceps.
instructions: Half-kneel with one knee down.
Tuck the pelvis and shift gently forward.
Switch sides halfway.
cues: Breathe slowly and relax into it.
exercises.safety: Mild tension only; never stretch into pain.

exercises.name: Lying glute stretch
exercises.description: Gentle static stretch for the glutes, hips.
instructions: Lie on your back and cross one ankle over the other knee.
Pull the lower leg gently toward you.
Switch sides halfway.
cues: Breathe slowly and relax into it.
exercises.safety: Mild tension only; never stretch into pain.

exercises.name: Side lunge stretch
exercises.description: Gentle static stretch for the adductors, hips.
instructions: Take a wide stance and shift your weight to one side, bending that knee.
Keep the other leg straight.
Switch sides halfway.
cues: Breathe slowly and relax into it.
exercises.safety: Mild tension only; never stretch into pain.

exercises.name: Standing forward bend
exercises.description: Gentle static stretch for the hamstrings, lower back.
instructions: Soften the knees and fold forward from the hips.
Let the arms and head hang.
cues: Breathe slowly and relax into it.
exercises.safety: Mild tension only; never stretch into pain.

exercises.name: Standing knee-to-chest stretch
exercises.video: Stretching/Lower Body/Standing Knee to Chest Stretch.mp4
exercises.description: Gentle static stretch for the glutes, hips.
instructions: Stand tall (hold a support if needed).
Hug one knee toward your chest.
Switch sides halfway.
cues: Breathe slowly and relax into it.
exercises.safety: Mild tension only; never stretch into pain.

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.description: Gentle static stretch for the back, lats, hips.
instructions: Kneel, sit back toward your heels and reach the arms forward.
Rest the forehead down and breathe.
cues: Breathe slowly and relax into it.
exercises.safety: Mild tension only; never stretch into pain.

exercises.name: Overhead triceps stretch
exercises.description: Gentle static stretch for the triceps, shoulders.
instructions: Reach one hand down your back.
Gently press the elbow with the other hand.
Switch sides halfway.
cues: Breathe slowly and relax into it.
exercises.safety: Mild tension only; never stretch into pain.

exercises.name: Rear shoulder stretch
exercises.description: Gentle static stretch for the rear shoulders, upper back.
instructions: Bring one arm across the chest.
Hold it gently with the other arm.
Switch sides halfway.
cues: Breathe slowly and relax into it.
exercises.safety: Mild tension only; never stretch into pain.

exercises.name: Doorway chest stretch
exercises.description: Gentle static stretch for the chest, front shoulders.
instructions: Place the forearm on a door frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step through gently.
Switch sides halfway.
cues: Breathe slowly and relax into it.
exercises.safety: Mild tension only; never stretch into pain.

exercises.name: Standing side bend stretch
exercises.description: Gentle static stretch for the obliques, lats.
instructions: Reach one arm overhead.
Lean gently to the opposite side.
Switch sides halfway.
cues: Breathe slowly and relax into it.
exercises.safety: Mild tension only; never stretch into pain.

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.description: Gentle spinal mobility on hands and knees.
instructions: On hands and knees, round the back up (cat).
Then let the chest sink and lift the head (cow). Move with your breath.

exercises.name: Downward-facing dog
exercises.description: Inverted V stretch for calves, hamstrings and shoulders.
instructions: From hands and knees, lift the hips up and back.
Press the heels toward the floor; knees can stay bent.
mistakes: Rounding the back to straighten the legs.
exercises.safety: Skip if wrists or shoulders are sore.

exercises.name: Open-book thoracic rotation
exercises.description: Side-lying upper-back rotation.
instructions: Lie on one side, knees bent, arms straight in front.
Open the top arm across to the other side, following it with your eyes.
Switch sides halfway.
exercises.progression: Pause for a breath at the end.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.description: A basic squat that trains leg strength and a controlled knee bend.
instructions: Feet about shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sit the hips back and down while the knees follow the toes.
Go to a depth you control, then stand up by pushing the floor away.
cues: Chest tall, whole foot on the floor.
exercises.safety: Use a depth that is pain-free.
exercises.regression: Squat to a chair or box.

exercises.name: Bodyweight sumo squat
exercises.description: A wide-stance squat.
instructions: Take a wide stance, toes turned out.
Lower straight down, knees pushing out over the toes.
Stand back up.

exercises.name: Split squat
exercises.description: A staggered-stance squat that builds single-leg strength and control.
instructions: Take a long split stance.
Lower the back knee toward the floor, front shin fairly upright.
Push through the front foot to rise. Do all reps on one side, then switch.
cues: Front knee over the middle of the foot.
exercises.safety: Shorten the range if the knee is uncomfortable.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.description: Rear-foot-elevated split squat.
instructions: Rest the back foot on a bench.
Lower straight down under control.
Drive up through the front foot. Switch sides after all reps.
cues: Most weight on the front leg.

exercises.name: Step-up
exercises.needs: A sturdy step or low box
exercises.description: Step onto a low, stable step and stand up tall.
instructions: Place one whole foot on a sturdy step (start low).
Push through that foot to stand up tall.
Step down slowly with the other foot. Finish one side, then switch.
cues: Push through the top foot, not the bottom one.
exercises.safety: Use a stable step; start low.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.description: Lying hip extension for the glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Squeeze the glutes and lift the hips until knees, hips and shoulders line up.
Lower slowly.
cues: Ribs down; lift with the glutes, not the back.
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top.
exercises.safety: Stop if you feel it in the lower back rather than the glutes.
exercises.progression: Single-leg glute bridge or hip thrust.

exercises.name: Bodyweight hip thrust
exercises.description: Hip extension with the upper back supported.
instructions: Upper back against a bench, feet flat.
Drive the hips up until the torso is level.
Lower with control.
exercises.safety: Keep the movement in the hips.

exercises.name: Calf raise
exercises.description: Raises onto the balls of the feet for calf and ankle strength.
instructions: Stand tall, hold a support if needed.
Rise onto the balls of the feet.
Lower slowly.
cues: Straight up and down; pause at the top.
mistakes: Rolling to the outside of the feet.
exercises.safety: Stop if the Achilles area is painful.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.description: Single-leg hip hinge for balance and hamstring control.
instructions: Stand on one leg, slight knee bend.
Hinge forward as the free leg reaches back.
Return to standing. Finish one side, then switch.
cues: Hips stay square to the floor.
exercises.safety: Touch a wall for balance if needed.

exercises.name: Single-leg balance
exercises.description: Quiet single-leg stance for ankle and hip control.
instructions: Stand on one foot with a slight knee bend, near a wall.
Hold still with the hips level.
Switch legs halfway.
cues: Grip the floor with the whole foot; hips level.
mistakes: Leaning on the wall the whole time.
exercises.progression: Eyes closed or reach with the free leg.

exercises.name: Controlled step-down
exercises.description: Slowly lower one heel from a step to train landing-style knee control.
instructions: Stand on a low step on one leg.
Slowly lower the other heel to touch the floor, keeping the knee in line with the toes.
Return to the top. Finish one side, then switch.
cues: Knee stays over the middle of the foot.
exercises.safety: Start with a very low step; hold a support if needed.
exercises.regression: Lower step or hold a support.

exercises.name: Snap-down to stick
exercises.description: Practise a quiet, balanced landing position without jumping.
instructions: Rise onto the toes with arms up.
Quickly drop into a quarter-squat landing position and freeze for two seconds.
Stand and repeat.
cues: Land quiet, knees over toes, chest up.
exercises.safety: No jumping needed; stop if knees or ankles hurt.

exercises.name: Low pogo hops
exercises.description: Small, quick, low hops for ankle stiffness and rhythm.
instructions: Stand tall, knees soft.
Make small hops (a few centimetres) off the balls of the feet.
Stay relaxed and quiet.
cues: Small and quiet; bounce off the floor.
exercises.safety: Low intensity only. Skip if you have any pain in feet, ankles or knees.

exercises.name: Squat to calf raise
exercises.description: Squat, then rise smoothly onto the toes; rehearses legs-then-extension without jumping.
instructions: Squat to a comfortable depth.
Stand up and continue smoothly onto the balls of the feet.
Lower the heels and repeat.
cues: Legs first, then rise all the way up.
mistakes: Rising onto toes before the legs straighten.

exercises.name: Dumbbell squat
exercises.description: Squat holding dumbbells.
instructions: Feet about shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sit the hips back and down while the knees follow the toes.
Go to a depth you control, then stand up by pushing the floor away.
cues: Chest tall, whole foot on the floor.
exercises.safety: Choose a weight you can control for every rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell split squat
exercises.description: Split squat holding dumbbells.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides in a long split stance.
Lower the back knee toward the floor.
Drive up through the front foot. Switch sides after all reps.
cues: Front knee over the middle of the foot.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.description: Hip hinge for hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of the thighs, knees soft.
Push the hips back, sliding the weights down the legs.
Stop when you feel the hamstrings, then stand by driving the hips forward.
exercises.safety: Light weight; stop before your back rounds.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
exercises.description: Hip thrust with a dumbbell on the hips.
instructions: Upper back on a bench, dumbbell on the hips.
Drive the hips up until level.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell seated calf raise
exercises.description: Seated calf raise with dumbbells on the knees.
instructions: Sit with dumbbells resting on the knees.
Raise the heels as high as possible.
Lower slowly.
cues: Full range, pause at the top.

exercises.name: Band squat
exercises.description: Squat against band resistance.
instructions: Feet about shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sit the hips back and down while the knees follow the toes.
Go to a depth you control, then stand up by pushing the floor away.
cues: Chest tall, whole foot on the floor.
exercises.safety: Check the band is not worn or torn.

exercises.name: Band split squat
exercises.description: Split squat with band resistance.
instructions: Stand on the band with the front foot in a split stance.
Lower the back knee toward the floor.
Drive up through the front foot. Switch sides after all reps.
cues: Front knee over the middle of the foot.
exercises.safety: Check the band is secure under the foot.

exercises.name: Band Bulgarian split squat
exercises.description: Rear-foot-elevated split squat with a band.
instructions: Back foot on a bench, front foot on the band.
Lower under control.
Drive up. Switch sides after all reps.
cues: Most weight on the front leg.

exercises.name: Band Romanian deadlift
exercises.description: Hip hinge against a band.
instructions: Stand on the band, holding the ends.
Push the hips back with a long back.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.name: Band glute bridge
exercises.description: Glute bridge with a band across the hips or knees.
instructions: Lie on your back, band in place, knees bent.
Squeeze the glutes and lift the hips.
Lower slowly.
cues: Lift with the glutes; ribs down.
exercises.safety: Stop if you feel it in the lower back.

exercises.name: Barbell back squat
exercises.description: Loaded squat for overall leg strength.
instructions: Bar on the upper back, feet shoulder-width.
Brace, then squat to a controlled depth.
Drive up, keeping the chest up.
exercises.safety: Use safety pins or spotter arms; choose a weight you can lift with good form for every rep.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.description: Loaded hip hinge.
instructions: Hold the bar at the thighs, knees soft.
Push the hips back, bar close to the legs.
Stand by driving the hips forward.
exercises.safety: Moderate weight; stop before the back rounds.

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust
exercises.description: Loaded hip extension.
instructions: Upper back on a bench, padded bar over the hips.
Drive the hips up until level.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Barbell split squat
exercises.description: Split squat with a barbell.
instructions: Bar on the upper back in a long split stance.
Lower the back knee.
Drive up. Switch sides after all reps.
exercises.safety: Use a rack; master the dumbbell version first.

exercises.name: Landmine front squat
exercises.description: Front-loaded squat with a landmine.
instructions: Hold the bar end at your chest.
Squat with the chest up.
Drive up.

exercises.name: Smith machine squat
exercises.description: Squat on a guided bar.
instructions: Bar on the upper back, feet slightly forward.
Squat to a controlled depth.
Drive up.
mistakes: Feet too far forward or back.

exercises.name: Smith machine split squat
exercises.description: Split squat on a guided bar.
instructions: Bar on the upper back in a split stance.
Lower the back knee.
Drive up. Switch sides after all reps.

exercises.name: Smith machine hip thrust
exercises.description: Hip thrust on a guided bar.
instructions: Upper back on a bench, padded bar over the hips.
Drive the hips up.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Smith machine Romanian deadlift
exercises.description: Hip hinge on a guided bar.
instructions: Hold the bar at the thighs.
Push the hips back with a long back.
Stand tall.

exercises.name: Smith machine calf raise
exercises.description: Standing calf raise on a guided bar.
instructions: Bar on the upper back.
Rise onto the balls of the feet.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Cable goblet squat
exercises.description: Squat holding a low cable handle at the chest.
instructions: Feet about shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sit the hips back and down while the knees follow the toes.
Go to a depth you control, then stand up by pushing the floor away.
cues: Chest tall, whole foot on the floor.

exercises.name: Cable Romanian deadlift
exercises.description: Hip hinge against a low cable.
instructions: Hold the low cable in front, knees soft.
Push the hips back with a long back.
Stand tall.

exercises.name: Cable lunge
exercises.description: Lunge holding a cable handle.
instructions: Hold the handle, step into a lunge.
Lower under control.
Return. Finish one side, then switch.

exercises.name: Cable calf raise
exercises.description: Calf raise against a low cable.
instructions: Hold the low cable, stand tall.
Rise onto the balls of the feet.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.description: Machine leg press.
instructions: Feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Lower under control without the hips curling up.
Press back without locking the knees hard.
cues: Lower back stays on the pad.
mistakes: Going so deep the hips roll up.

exercises.name: Machine hip thrust
exercises.description: Hip thrust on a machine.
instructions: Set up with the pad over the hips.
Drive the hips up.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise machine
exercises.description: Machine seated calf raise.
instructions: Pad over the knees.
Raise the heels.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Hack squat machine
exercises.description: Machine squat.
instructions: Back on the pad, feet shoulder-width.
Lower under control.
Press up.

exercises.name: TRX assisted squat
exercises.description: Squat holding the straps for support.
instructions: Hold the handles, arms straight.
Sit back into a squat using the straps lightly.
Stand up.
cues: Use the straps for balance, not to pull.

exercises.name: TRX lunge
exercises.description: Lunge holding the straps for balance.
instructions: Hold the handles.
Step back into a lunge.
Return. Finish one side, then switch.

exercises.name: TRX glute bridge
exercises.description: Glute bridge with heels in the straps.
instructions: Lie on your back, heels in the foot cradles.
Lift the hips.
Lower slowly.
exercises.safety: Stop if you feel it in the lower back.

exercises.name: TRX calf raise
exercises.description: Calf raise holding the straps.
instructions: Hold the handles.
Rise onto the balls of the feet.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: TRX Romanian deadlift
exercises.description: Single-leg hinge holding the straps.
instructions: Hold the handles, stand on one leg.
Hinge forward, free leg reaching back.
Return. Finish one side, then switch.

exercises.name: TRX reverse lunge to knee drive
exercises.video: TRX Suspension/Legs/TRX Reverse Lunge to Knee Drive.mp4
exercises.description: Reverse lunge then drive the knee up, holding the straps.
instructions: Hold the handles and step back into a lunge.
Drive up through the front foot and lift the back knee.
Finish one side, then switch.
cues: Push the floor away, then drive the knee.

exercises.name: TRX pistol squat
exercises.description: Assisted single-leg squat.
instructions: Hold the handles, stand on one leg.
Squat down with the other leg forward.
Stand up. Finish one side, then switch.
cues: Knee over the middle of the foot.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.description: Slow opposite arm-and-leg reaches while keeping the lower back still.
instructions: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent at 90°.
Slowly extend one arm and the opposite leg.
Return and alternate sides.
cues: Lower back stays gently pressed down.
exercises.safety: Shorten the reach if your back arches.

exercises.name: Front plank
exercises.description: Hold a straight line from head to heels on forearms and toes.
instructions: Forearms under shoulders, legs straight behind.
Brace and hold a straight line.
exercises.safety: Stop when you lose the position.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.description: Hold on one forearm and the side of the feet.
instructions: Lie on your side, elbow under the shoulder.
Lift the hips into a straight line.
Switch sides halfway.
exercises.safety: Knees-down version if the shoulder is sensitive.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.description: On hands and knees, reach the opposite arm and leg while keeping the trunk still.
instructions: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Return and alternate.
cues: Keep a glass of water balanced on your back.
exercises.safety: Small reach if the back is sensitive.

exercises.name: Plank shoulder taps
exercises.description: High plank, tapping opposite shoulders without rocking.
instructions: High plank, feet wider than hips.
Tap one hand to the opposite shoulder.
Alternate without twisting.
exercises.safety: Skip if wrists or shoulders hurt.

exercises.name: Band dead bug leg lowering
exercises.video: Resistance Band/ABS/Band Dead Bug Leg Lowering.mp4
exercises.description: Dead bug variation with band tension.
instructions: Lie on your back holding the band overhead.
Lower one leg slowly while keeping the back still.
Alternate legs.
exercises.safety: Shorten the range if the back lifts.

exercises.name: Band Pallof press
exercises.needs: A band anchored at chest height
exercises.description: Press a band straight out from the chest and resist rotation.
instructions: Stand side-on to the anchor holding the band at the chest.
Press the hands straight out and hold for a breath, resisting the twist.
Bring them back. Finish one side, then switch.
exercises.regression: Lighter band or closer to the anchor.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof press
exercises.description: Press a cable handle straight out from the chest and resist rotation.
instructions: Stand side-on to the cable at chest height.
Press the handle out and hold for a breath.
Return. Finish one side, then switch.

exercises.name: TRX side bridge
exercises.description: Side plank with feet in the straps.
instructions: Feet in the cradles, on one forearm.
Lift the hips into a line.
Switch sides halfway.

exercises.name: Body saw
exercises.description: Forearm plank, sliding the body forwards and back.
instructions: Forearm plank on a slippery surface or sliders.
Slide the body back and forth a short distance.

exercises.name: TRX body saw
exercises.description: Forearm plank with feet in the straps, sliding forwards and back.
instructions: Feet in the cradles, forearm plank.
Rock the body forward and back a short distance.

exercises.name: Alternating superman
exercises.description: Lying face down, lift the opposite arm and leg.
instructions: Lie face down, arms forward.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg a little.
Lower and alternate.
exercises.safety: Keep lifts small if the back is sensitive.

exercises.name: Dumbbell renegade row
exercises.description: High plank on dumbbells, rowing one at a time without rotating.
instructions: High plank on two dumbbells, feet wide.
Row one dumbbell to the ribs.
Lower and alternate.

exercises.name: Band external rotation
exercises.description: Hold a light band in both hands and rotate the forearms outward, elbows at your sides.
instructions: Hold the band in both hands, palms up, elbows tucked at your sides and bent to 90°.
Rotate both forearms outward to stretch the band.
Return slowly.
cues: Elbow stays glued to the side.
mistakes: Using a band that is too heavy.

exercises.name: Cable external rotation
exercises.description: External rotation against a light cable.
instructions: Elbow at the side, bent to 90°.
Rotate the forearm outward.
Return slowly. Finish one side, then switch.

exercises.name: Band face pull
exercises.video: Resistance Band/Shoulders/Band Half Kneeling Face Pull.mp4
exercises.description: Pull the band toward the face with elbows high.
instructions: Half-kneel facing the anchor.
Pull toward your face, hands finishing beside the ears.
Return slowly.
cues: Lead with the elbows; squeeze shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Cable face pull
exercises.description: Rope face pull on a cable.
instructions: Rope at upper-chest height.
Pull toward your face, elbows high.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: TRX face pull
exercises.description: Face pull with the straps.
instructions: Hold the handles, lean back slightly.
Pull hands toward the face, elbows high.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell reverse fly
exercises.description: Bent-over reverse fly.
instructions: Hinge forward with a long back, light dumbbells hanging.
Raise the arms out to the sides.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Band reverse fly
exercises.video: Resistance Band/Shoulders/Band Bent Over Reverse Fly.mp4
exercises.description: Bent-over reverse fly with a band.
instructions: Stand on the band, hinge forward.
Raise the arms out to the sides.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: TRX row
exercises.description: Inverted row with the straps.
instructions: Hold the handles, lean back, body straight.
Pull the chest to the hands.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Band seated row
exercises.description: Seated row with a band around the feet.
instructions: Sit tall, band around the feet.
Row the hands to the ribs.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Cable seated row
exercises.description: Seated cable row.
instructions: Sit tall, knees soft.
Row the handle to the ribs.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Seated row machine
exercises.description: Machine seated row.
instructions: Chest on the pad.
Row the handles back.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bent-over row
exercises.description: Bent-over row with dumbbells.
instructions: Hinge forward with a long back.
Row the dumbbells to the ribs.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Smith machine bent-over row
exercises.description: Bent-over row on a guided bar.
instructions: Hinge forward under the bar.
Row it to the lower ribs.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell bent-over row
exercises.description: Bent-over row with a barbell.
instructions: Hinge forward with a long back.
Row the bar to the lower ribs.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Band triceps pushdown
exercises.description: Straighten the elbows against a band anchored high.
instructions: Elbows at your sides.
Push the band down until the arms are straight.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Cable triceps pushdown
exercises.description: Triceps pushdown on a cable.
instructions: Elbows at your sides.
Push down until the arms are straight.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell triceps kickback
exercises.description: Bent-over kickback.
instructions: Hinge forward, upper arms by your sides.
Straighten the elbows back.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell overhead triceps extension
exercises.description: Overhead triceps extension.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower it behind the head by bending the elbows.
Straighten the arms.

exercises.name: TRX triceps extension
exercises.description: Triceps extension leaning into the straps.
instructions: Face away from the anchor, arms forward.
Bend the elbows to lower the head toward the hands.
Straighten the arms.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
exercises.description: Push-up with hands raised.
instructions: Hands on a raised surface, body straight.
Lower the chest to the edge.
Push back up.
exercises.safety: Higher surface if shoulders are sensitive.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.description: Standard push-up.
instructions: Hands under shoulders, body straight.
Lower until the chest is near the floor.
Push back up.
exercises.safety: Use the incline version if form breaks.

exercises.name: TRX chest press
exercises.description: Push-up pattern leaning into the straps.
instructions: Face away from the anchor, arms straight in front.
Lower the chest between the hands.
Press back.

exercises.name: Band chest press
exercises.description: Standing press against a band.
instructions: Band anchored behind you at chest height.
Press the hands forward.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Band shoulder press
exercises.description: Overhead press against a band.
instructions: Stand on the band, hands at the shoulders.
Press overhead.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell seated shoulder press
exercises.description: Seated overhead dumbbell press.
instructions: Sit tall, dumbbells at the shoulders.
Press overhead.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Chest press machine
exercises.description: Machine chest press.
instructions: Handles at chest height.
Press forward.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Cable chest press
exercises.description: Standing cable press.
instructions: Handles at chest height.
Press forward.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Smith machine bench press
exercises.description: Bench press on a guided bar.
instructions: Lie under the bar.
Lower to the chest.
Press up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.description: Bench press with dumbbells.
instructions: Lie on a bench, dumbbells over the chest.
Lower beside the chest.
Press up.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
exercises.needs: A bench, rack and spotter or safeties
exercises.description: Barbell bench press.
instructions: Lie under the bar, grip slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower to the chest.
Press up.

exercises.name: Step-up intervals
exercises.description: Steady stepping up and down a low step at a conversational pace.
instructions: Step up with one foot, then the other.
Step down the same way.
Switch the leading leg each interval.
exercises.safety: Low step; keep a pace you can talk at.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.description: Squat, plank, return and jump.
instructions: Squat and place the hands down.
Step or jump back to a plank.
Return and stand or jump.
exercises.safety: High impact: only if you are comfortable with jumping.

exercises.name: TRX mountain climber
exercises.description: Mountain climbers with feet in the straps.
instructions: High plank with feet in the cradles.
Drive the knees in alternately.

exercises.name: Band mountain climber
exercises.description: Mountain climbers with a band around the feet.
instructions: High plank, band around the feet.
Drive the knees in alternately.
exercises.safety: Slow down if the wrists hurt.
